rows.role_title: General Secretary of the Communist Party of India (Marxist)
rows.text: People's Democracy reports that at Kozhikode on April 9, when the delegates marched to the public meeting concluding the 20th Congress, 'the newly elected general secretary of CPI(M), Prakash Karat, took the salute from the dais' of the volunteers' march.
